title: Annihilation of Caste: The Annotated Critical Edition (with introduction 'The Doctor and the Saint' by Arundhati Roy)

verification.verification_notes: Critical edition identity confirmed via publisher and review records (Navayana, New Delhi, 2014; introduction by Arundhati Roy). Establishes the text's origin as an undelivered 1936 speech, self-published 15 May 1936, and its reception as a manifesto.

limitations: English-language Indian text; the rhetorical situation is Indian but the original language is English, which limits any non-Anglophone claim.

copyright.notes: Navayana annotated edition; analytical citation only.
